nodes.label: Daily-already-played UX design (tombstoned)
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Tombstoned 2026-06-12: the daily-puzzle/retention feature this spec designed was removed in PR #97. Kept unmodified for history — do not implement from it.

nodes.label: Played-card primary + secondary affordances
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: One emerald button did both 'I'm done' and 'tap to see reveal', so a played card read as a play entry point and the game felt like it instantly ended. Split into a teal primary Play button and a small secondary reveal row; the emerald border and check stay as the done signal.

nodes.label: Play-unlimited CTA in the daily reveal overlay
nodes.author: Tobias Ens (with Claude)
nodes.rationale: Adding a bottom close link would violate 'one obvious way to close', so only the Play button is added and the header X stays the sole close affordance. No new analytics event: the hash router's free_started on boot is the durable signal, and firing launcher_dismissed from the reveal overlay would be a category error.
